spans.note: The system prompt describes extensive data persistence mechanisms (SQLite storage, session summaries, scratchpad persistence, memory indexing, embedding caches) but includes no mention of user consent, data retention policies, transparency about what is stored, or user control over their data. The memory_append tool writes to persistent files and databases without any described consent mechanism. Session data is automatically persisted at session end without user awareness or control. The workspace memory system indexes and stores user interactions with no privacy safeguards mentioned.
